meta.source: OpenStreetMap ODbL 1.0, Overpass 2026-09-05, plus procedural densification of the historic core
meta.note: OSM mapping of Gamberale is sparse (34 footprints). Extra houses are placed along residential streets without overlapping OSM footprints so the borgo reads as a packed hilltown. Landmarks (castle, San Lorenzo, town hall) use OSM geometry.
